settings.heading: The Leader in Custom DTF Transfers
What is DTF?
settings.text: Direct to Film (DTF) Transfers are incredibly vivid, high quality transfers that can be applied to almost any product, material, and color with just a heat press, Cricut, or iron. Millions trust DTF Transfers for their events, team merch, crafts, gifts, and more — DTF saves you money and time, and lets you customize products the way you want.

settings.heading: Pressing DTF Transfers Has Never Been Easier
settings.text: With our proprietary fast-peel process, our DTF Transfers give you professional results in just 13 seconds. Now you can press on anything!

settings.question: What is a DTF transfer?
settings.answer: A direct-to-film transfer is printed art on a film that's heat-applied to fabric, offering vivid color and strong durability.

settings.question: Is there a minimum order?
settings.answer: No — order exactly the size and quantity you need.

settings.question: What equipment do I need?
settings.answer: A heat press, household iron, or Cricut EasyPress will all work.

settings.question: How long do transfers last?
settings.answer: Properly pressed transfers are built to withstand repeated washing without cracking or fading.

settings.question: How fast is production?
settings.answer: Most orders are printed and shipped within 1–2 business days.
